name: Blood Runner
lore: Proposition originale pour le jeu d’après le catalogue de la conversation véhicules ; aucune fidélité canonique 1:1 revendiquée.

assets.label: Blood Runner — châssis, deux orientations
assets.prompt: Create an original Yautja-inspired fan-game vehicle proposal for La Longue Chasse, not a canonical film replica. Exactly two full horizontal side-profile views SIDE BY SIDE, two columns one row: left craft faces RIGHT, right craft faces LEFT, separately authored opposite sides of the same construction at identical scale. Side-scrolling camera, no top-down or isometric presentation. Each complete craft inside central70percent of its half with broad blank margins, full nose/rear visible. Flat pure MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no shadows, checker, letters, logo, grid or environment. Detailed hand-painted game bitmap. No pilot, people, bodies, cargo, trophies, skulls, loose chains, exhaust, projectiles or energy beams: these are independent modules later. BLOOD RUNNER, a brutally improvised outlaw antigravity motorcycle chassis. Compact low fast profile, exposed mismatched stolen antigravity turbine housings, patched blackened gunmetal armor with a few dark rust-red plates, crude metal welds, asymmetrical service covers that remain coherent between opposite-side views, bent-but-functional handlebars, one battered riding saddle, exposed protected cabling. Reinforced empty side hardpoints for removable blades and an illegal plasma weapon, several small empty trophy sockets, a small boxy identification jammer antenna. No actual skulls, chains, lateral blades or cannon fitted in this base layer. Must feel scavenged and illicit but mechanically intact, not a pile of disconnected scrap. No wheels, tracks or fake engine parts dangling in space.
notes: Châssis vide ; armements, passagers et effets doivent rester des modules indépendants.
Proposition graphique à contrôler en assemblage ; aucune animation ni conduite en jeu validée.
